steps.description: Pre-filter genes to keep those with >=10 counts in at least 3 samples (smallest group size). Fit DESeq2 with design ~ condition + time + condition:time, with condition and time reference levels set explicitly (report which level is reference for each). Test the condition:time interaction coefficient with the Wald test. Also extract the simple effect of condition within the reference time level (main effect coefficient) and the simple effect of condition within the other time level (main effect + interaction, via a named contrast/lfcShrink with ashr since it is not a single coefficient). Apply ashr shrinkage to all three effect estimates (interaction, simple effect at reference time, simple effect at other time). Report unshrunken LFC, shrunken LFC, lfcSE, p-value and BH-adjusted p-value (alpha=0.05, independent filtering on) for all three, each clearly labeled by contrast. Inspect and report the p-value histogram for each of the three tests before trusting the adjusted p-values. Flag genes with NA p-values from Cook's distance outlier detection (3 replicates/cell, so DESeq2 sets padj to NA rather than replacing counts). State explicitly, per the low-power flag: with 3 replicates per cell the interaction test has low power — a gene absent from the interaction list is not evidence the effect is equal across timepoints.

plan.title: Treatment x time interaction DE analysis (2x2, n=3)
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question — does the treatment effect differ between t0 and t1 — is an interaction question in a 2 condition x 2 timepoint design with 3 replicates per cell (12000 genes x 12 samples, single batch, raw Salmon counts). Design: ~ condition * time (or ~ cell equivalently), testing the condition:time interaction coefficient with DESeq2. QC first establishes whether samples cluster by condition/time as expected and flags outliers before the model is trusted. The interaction test is the primary answer to the question, but with only 3 replicates per cell the interaction coefficient (a difference of differences) has low power, so simple effects (treatment effect within t0, treatment effect within t1) are reported alongside it at the same threshold, never as a substitute. LFC is shrunk with ashr (contrast-based, since interaction/simple-effect comparisons are not single model coefficients). fgsea preranked enrichment on the Wald statistic runs against MSigDB Hallmark (staged, human) for each of the three result sets (interaction, simple effect at t0, simple effect at t1) to give pathway-level context to a design that individual-gene testing alone may under-power. A final report consolidates DE tables, diagnostics, power caveats, and enrichment results.
